assumptions: The REF allele must match the sequence at that position, and is checked.
bio.jane/contract.question: What sequence results from substituting this called ALT allele?

description: Substitute one called ALT allele into a sequence and return the edited bases, the range the edit occupies and the length change. The REF allele is checked against the sequence first and a mismatch REFUSES naming both: applying a call from a different assembly would produce a construct that looks fine and is wrong. Symbolic and breakend alleles are refused for what they are: they name a rearrangement rather than replacement bases.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alt_index.description: which ALT of a multiallelic record to apply, counting from 1 as the file lists them. Default the first.

contig.description: the contig of the record to apply, as the file names it.

file.description: which call set the variant comes from, by name. Unset, it is the project's only one.

offset.description: the coordinate this sequence's FIRST base has in the call set's contig. Default 1, meaning the sequence starts at the contig's start. A plasmid extracted from a genome sets this to where it was cut from, which is what lets a genomic call be applied to it at all.

pos.description: the POS of the record to apply, 1-based as VCF writes it.

name: apply_variant_call

applied.description: the record as applied: chrom, pos, ref, the ALT chosen and its index, so a run record says which allele of a multiallelic site was taken

delta.description: signed length change, which is what any annotation downstream of the edit must shift by

edited_end.description: 0-based INCLUSIVE end of the edited range in the new sequence. Inclusive, not half-open, because it is the end of a selection a reader is meant to see highlighted rather than a slice bound

edited_start.description: 0-based inclusive start of the range the edit occupies in the NEW sequence, for selecting it

sequence.description: the sequence with this ALT substituted for the REF, ready to wire into a next step. Every base outside the edited range is unchanged, and the length differs from the input by `delta`, so any coordinate downstream of `edited_start` has moved by that much

summary.description: the edit in one sentence, generated from this run
